# Blu Idol (BLU = Bring Luxury to You)
> India's premier demi-fine jewellery brand offering 18K gold-plated, waterproof, anti-tarnish, and hypoallergenic pieces for sensitive skin.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Blu Idol
- **Brand Acronym / Slogan**: BLU = Bring Luxury To You
- **Website**: https://www.bluidol.in
- **Customer Care & Direct WhatsApp Ordering**: +91 9895432549
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/blu_idol/
- **Target Market**: India (Pan-India delivery)

## Core Value Propositions
- **18K Gold Vacuum-Plated**: Advanced PVD vacuum-plating process delivering enduring 18K yellow gold brilliance.
- **100% Skin-Safe & Hypoallergenic**: Guaranteed nickel-free and lead-free; specifically engineered for highly sensitive skin with zero irritation.
- **Waterproof & Sweat-Proof**: Resistant to water, sweat, humidity, and perfume. Suitable for everyday shower, workout, and swimming wear.
- **Anti-Tarnish Guarantee**: Lab-tested materials resist oxidation, fading, and discoloration.
- **Direct WhatsApp Concierge**: Instant ordering and customer support via WhatsApp at +91 9895432549.

## How to Order
1. Browse pieces on https://www.bluidol.in/#shop
2. Click any "Order on WhatsApp" button or message +91 9895432549 with your preferred item.
3. Secure payment via UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, or Cards.
4. Free shipping across India on orders above ₹999. Typical delivery in 3-5 business days.
